Feature: System Backup and User Authentication

  Scenario: Nightly Backup and Password Change
  Given the system is operational at the end of the day
  When the system initiates a full backup
  Then the backup data should be sent to the remote site
  And the backup data should be rotated every 30 days

  Scenario: Password Change for Doctors/Chemists/Labs
  Given a doctor, chemist, or lab has valid credentials
  When they attempt to change their password
  Then the system should accept the new password

  Scenario: Patient Registration and User-id Creation
  Given a patient is registering
  When they create a user-id and password
  Then the system should use the user-id for authentication

  Scenario: Doctor Appointment Report Generation
  Given a doctor is logged in
  When they request an appointment report for the next 5 days
  Then the system should generate the report

  Scenario: Speciality Consultation Report Generation
  Given a doctor is logged in
  When they request a consultation report for the last day of the month
  Then the system should generate the report

  Scenario: Speciality Revenue Report Generation
  Given a doctor is logged in
  When they request a revenue report for the last day of the month
  Then the system should generate the report

  | Backup rotation | Date       | Expected outcome |
  | 1st rotation    | 30 days ago | Success          |
  | 2nd rotation    | 29 days ago | Success          |
  | ...            | ...        | ...             |

  | Appointment report | Valid request | Success          |
  | Appointment report | Invalid request | Failure          |
  | Consultation report | Valid request | Success          |

Feature: System Backup and User Authentication

  As a system administrator, I want to ensure that the system performs nightly backups and rotates them every 30 days.
  As a doctor, I want to change my password and log in using my credentials.
  As a patient, I want to create a user-id and password for authentication purposes.
  As a system analyst, I want to generate specific reports for doctors, specialties, and patients.

Scenario Outline: System Backup and User Authentication
  Given the system is operational at midnight
    When the backup process starts
      Then the backup of the database and code should be initiated
      And the backup should be rotated every 30 days

  Given a doctor has valid credentials
    When the doctor changes the password
      Then the system should accept the new password
      And the doctor should be able to log in

  Given a patient has valid credentials
    When the patient creates a user-id and password
      Then the system should accept the new credentials
      And the patient should be able to authenticate

  Given the system is operational on the last day of the month
    When the report generation process starts
      Then the system should generate the specified reports

Scenario Outline: Reports Generation
  Given the system is operational on the last day of the month
    When the report generation process starts
      Then the system should generate the following reports:
      - Doctor wise Appointment file for next 5 days
      - Speciality wise - Number of Consultations by Doctor per month/quarter/year
      - Speciality wise - Revenue Earned per month/quarter/year
